question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words in the given sentence.**

He was **__severe in his manner__**, due to his rigidly puritanical outlook.
solution:
The correct answer is "austere."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words** "severe in his manner,"** in the given sentence is **"austere."**
 
• **"Austere" **means stern or strict in appearance or manner, often due to adherence to strict moral or ethical principles, which aligns well with the description provided in the sentence. ((व्‍यक्ति) अतिसंयमी और गंभीर)
 
 
• **Example**: *The monastery's **austere**__ decor reflected the monks' commitment to simplicity and self-discipline.*
 
 

The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Faithful: **always staying with and supporting a person, organization or belief. ((व्‍यक्ति, संस्‍था, मत आदि के प्रति) सच्‍चा और निष्‍ठावान)
 
• **Authentic: **that you know is real or genuine. (प्रामाणिक, असली)
 
• **Precise: **clear and accurate. (स्‍पष्‍ट और सही)
